title: Cocoa Bar
description: 🍫 Cocoa Bar adds a special chocolate chocolate bar with effects
body: 🍫 Cocoa Bar is a Minecraft Forge mod that adds a special chocolate bar item designed for survival and adventure gameplay. This food item restores hunger and provides useful temporary effects such as Regeneration and Haste, giving players a quick energy boost during exploration or combat. It also includes a custom 3D model and texture, making it feel unique and more immersive than standard vanilla food items. The mod is lightweight, simple, and fully compatible with both singleplayer and multiplayer servers.
